mapper.sql: SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, p.project_status AS projectStatus, s.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, s.limit_per_order AS limitPerOrder, s.delivery_type AS deliveryType, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, sku.sku_id AS skuId, sku.sku_name AS skuName, sku.price AS unitPrice, sku.stock_available AS stockAvailable, sku.sku_status AS skuStatus, sku.inventory_authority AS inventoryAuthority FROM performance_project p JOIN performance_session s ON s.project_id = p.project_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id JOIN ticket_sku sku ON sku.project_id = p.project_id AND sku.session_id = s.session_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND sku.sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, p.project_status AS projectStatus, s.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, s.limit_per_order AS limitPerOrder, s.delivery_type AS deliveryType, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, sku.sku_id AS skuId, sku.sku_name AS skuName, sku.price AS unitPrice, sku.stock_available AS stockAvailable, sku.sku_status AS skuStatus, sku.inventory_authority AS inventoryAuthority FROM performance_project p JOIN performance_session s ON s.project_id = p.project_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id JOIN ticket_sku sku ON sku.project_id = p.project_id AND sku.session_id = s.session_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND sku.sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.description AS description, r.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM project_service_tag_rel r JOIN service_tag t ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.tag_name NOT IN ('条件退', '不可退')
UNION ALL
SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, COALESCE(NULLIF(rr.rule_description, ''), t.description) AS description, 99 AS sortOrder FROM refund_rule rr JOIN service_tag t ON ( (rr.refund_type = 'CONDITIONAL_REFUND' AND t.tag_name = '条件退') OR (rr.refund_type = 'NO_REFUND' AND t.tag_name = '不可退') ) WHERE rr.project_id = #{projectId}
ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, tagId ASC

SELECT CONCAT( CASE WHEN rs.max_before_start_minutes IS NULL THEN CONCAT('演出开始前', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END, '及以上') WHEN rs.min_before_start_minutes = 0 THEN CONCAT('演出开始前', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END, '内') ELSE CONCAT('演出开始前', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END, '至', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END) END, '：', CASE rs.stage_result WHEN 'FREE' THEN '免费退票' WHEN 'FEE_PERCENT' THEN CONCAT('收取', CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(rs.fee_rate, 0) * 100, 2) AS CHAR), '%手续费') WHEN 'FEE_FIXED' THEN CONCAT('收取￥', CAST(IFNULL(rs.fixed_fee_amount, 0) AS CHAR), '手续费') WHEN 'NOT_ALLOWED' THEN '不可退票' ELSE '以项目退款规则为准' END ) FROM refund_rule rr JOIN refund_rule_stage rs ON rs.refund_rule_id = rr.refund_rule_id WHERE rr.project_id = #{projectId} AND rr.refund_type = 'CONDITIONAL_REFUND' ORDER BY rs.sort_order ASC, rs.stage_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o JOIN order_audience oa ON oa.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.session_id = #{sessionId} AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUND_SUCCESS') AND oa.certificate_no_hash IN
#{certificateNoHash}

SELECT address_id AS addressId, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, province AS province, city AS city, district AS district, country_code AS countryCode, province_code AS provinceCode, city_code AS cityCode, area_code AS areaCode, detail_address AS detailAddress FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND address_id = #{addressId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_sku SET stock_available = stock_available - #{quantity}, stock_locked = stock_locked + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND stock_available >= #{quantity}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_order (order_no, user_id, project_id, session_id, order_status, delivery_type, fulfillment_mode, ticket_amount, service_fee_amount, delivery_fee_amount, discount_amount, total_amount, pay_amount, payment_status, pay_method, pay_expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, ticket_issued_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{projectId}, #{sessionId}, #{orderStatus}, #{deliveryType}, #{fulfillmentMode}, #{ticketAmount}, #{serviceFeeAmount}, #{deliveryFeeAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, NULL, #{payExpireTime}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, sku_id, sku_name, unit_price, face_price, provider_sale_price, settlement_price, quantity, subtotal_amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{skuName}, #{unitPrice}, #{facePrice}, #{providerSalePrice}, #{settlementPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotalAmount})

INSERT INTO order_audience (order_id, real_name, certificate_type, certificate_no, certificate_no_hash, phone) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{audience.realName}, #{audience.certificateType}, #{audience.certificateNo}, #{audience.certificateNoHash}, #{audience.phone})

INSERT INTO order_address (order_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, country_code, province_code, city_code, area_code, detail_address) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{address.receiverName}, #{address.receiverPhone}, #{address.province}, #{address.city}, #{address.district}, #{address.countryCode}, #{address.provinceCode}, #{address.cityCode}, #{address.areaCode}, #{address.detailAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, user_id AS userId, order_status AS orderStatus, fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM ticket_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_item_id AS orderItemId, order_id AS orderId, sku_id AS skuId, quantity AS quantity FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_sku SET stock_locked = stock_locked - #{quantity}, stock_available = stock_available + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND stock_locked >= #{quantity}
